faq.q1: Does it work on an iPhone?
faq.a1: Yes. Hold your card against the top of an iPhone XS or newer and a notification pops up. Older iPhones simply scan the QR code.
faq.q2: Do I or the other person need an app?
faq.a2: No. Your card opens in the browser of any iPhone or Android.
faq.a3: Send me the change. I update your card and your card, link and QR code keep working. Depending on your package, {updates_min} to {updates_max} updates are included in the first year.
faq.a4: You get your free Wallet card within a minute. Your custom preview within 48 hours. After your approval, your NFC card arrives within {levering} working days.
faq.q5: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a5: Yes, for example name.yourcompany.com. It's included in Signature and available with the other packages for +{prijs_domein}. The domain stays yours. Without your own domain, your card lives at a Salix address with your name.
faq.a6: The photo of your paper card is deleted as soon as your details have been read. There are no cookies or trackers on your card. You can always delete your free card and your data yourself via the link in your email.
faq.a7: Your card is custom-made for you, so the 14-day right of withdrawal does not apply. That's why you always see your design first, before your card is made.
faq.q8: Can I order for my team?
faq.a8: Yes. Order {team_koop} cards and get the {team_totaal}th one free, and from {team_betaalplan} cards you pay half now and half on delivery.
